description: This file is a shell script that serves as a test suite for Git packfile delta and island packing features. It defines functions to generate commits, determine delta bases, and performs a series of tests to verify behavior of Git's repack command with respect to delta islands, delta bases, and packfile ordering. The tests include setting up repositories, creating commits with specific relationships, and verifying the resulting packfile object order and delta base choices.

methods.name: is_delta_base
methods.description: Determines if the given object is a delta base against a specified object.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a file containing generated and appended content, updates refs, and sets shell variables to the commit hash.
